rubric.review_note: Use the PRD v7 rubric for all six checks on each case. A conversation can have more than one defect. Record a message ID and the relevant evidence for any defect, referral or policy conflict. Use the policy version in effect at the time of the reply. Where documents with the same title have different effective times, the most recent effective version applies.

policies.title: AI disclosure
policies.text: A visible notice must identify Fieldbook's AI assistant by its first reply. The assistant must accurately describe itself throughout the chat.

policies.title: Human handoff
policies.text: Transfer to a person for an explicit human request, a billing dispute, a legal threat, a safety issue, or after two unsuccessful troubleshooting attempts for the same problem. Use the billing queue for billing disputes. Include a short summary of the request and any troubleshooting in the transfer record. A billing how-to question or an unsuccessful payment with no charge can be handled in chat.

policies.title: Safe support
policies.text: Support must never request or repeat full card numbers, security codes, passwords, or one-time sign-in codes. Use the secure checkout or sign-in screen for those values. A nonsecret receipt ID and the last four card digits are acceptable for identifying a charge.

policies.title: Support tone
policies.text: Use respectful, clear language. Avoid sarcasm, blaming the customer, and dismissing their concern.

policies.title: Annual plan refund policy
policies.text: New annual plans qualify for a full refund within 14 calendar days of purchase. After day 14, a refund requires a billing manager's recorded approval. Monthly charges require a billing manager's approval. A request can be opened in Workspace settings > Billing > Request a refund. Eligibility is not approval or a scheduled action.

policies.title: Annual plan refund policy
policies.text: New annual plans qualify for a full refund within 10 calendar days of purchase. After day 10, a refund requires a billing manager's recorded approval. Monthly charges require a billing manager's approval. A request can be opened in Workspace settings > Billing > Request a refund. Eligibility is not approval or a scheduled action.

policies.title: Annual plan refund terms published in the Help Center
policies.text: The published refund terms say new annual plans qualify for a full refund within 30 calendar days of purchase. Requests can be opened in Workspace settings > Billing > Request a refund.

policies.title: Refund approval and fulfilment
policies.text: Promise a specific refund or date only with authorization and a matching scheduled or issued action. An approved refund still needs an issue event or scheduled issue. Once issued, a refund usually appears on the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days. Cancellation alone does not issue a refund. The billing action log is authoritative for approval, scheduling, and issue.

policies.title: Where to check a refund
policies.text: Workspace owners can check refund requests in Workspace settings > Billing > Requests. If the lookup is unavailable, direct the customer to that screen.

policies.title: Checkout and disputed charges
policies.text: Fieldbook accepts Visa, Mastercard, and American Express through secure checkout. PayPal, wire transfers, and gift cards are unavailable. If checkout failed without charging the card, check the billing postal code and retry once in secure checkout. For a disputed or duplicate posted charge, transfer to billing with the receipt ID if available.

policies.title: Invoices and receipts
policies.text: Workspace owners open Workspace settings > Billing > Invoices, select the month, then choose Download PDF. Workspace members can ask an owner for a copy. The invoice tool is authoritative for specific totals, invoice status, and seat counts.

policies.title: Pro plan price list
policies.text: Pro costs $12 USD per seat per month before taxes and discounts. An invoice total represents all billed seats, plus or minus any applicable adjustments.

policies.title: Account deletion
policies.text: Open Profile > Privacy > Delete account and confirm via the signed-in confirmation page. A sole workspace owner must transfer ownership first. Support chat cannot bypass confirmation or delete the account directly. The action log records confirmations and deletions.

policies.title: Profile and workspaces
policies.text: Change name or email in Profile > Account details. A change of email takes effect after verification of the new address. Use the workspace picker in the top left to switch workspaces on the same account. To use a different account, select the avatar and Sign out, then sign in with the other account. Fieldbook does not limit accounts to a single device.

policies.title: Password reset
policies.text: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page. The reset email contains a link valid for 30 minutes. For an expired link, request a fresh one. After two failed troubleshooting attempts, transfer to a person with a summary. A sign-in code should only be entered on Fieldbook's secure sign-in screen.

policies.title: Sign-up
policies.text: Choose Create account on the sign-in page, enter the email address, and follow the verification link. A verification link is valid for 30 minutes. If an email is already registered, sign in or use Forgot password for that email.

policies.title: Plan cancellation
policies.text: A workspace owner can turn off renewal in Workspace settings > Billing > Manage plan. There is no early termination fee. Access continues until the end of the period already paid for. Cancellation alone does not issue a refund.

policies.title: Complaint intake
policies.text: Customers can send a complaint through Help > Contact support > Feedback. When the customer explicitly asks for a person or raises a legal threat, use the human handoff workflow.
